```{r setup}

library(lme4)

knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo=TRUE, message=FALSE, warning=TRUE,
```

```{r helper-functions}
pupil_make_centered_face <- function() {
  fun <- refund::mfpca.face
  expressions <- as.list(body(fun))
  expected <- as.list(quote({
    meanY <- colMeans(df$Y, na.rm = TRUE)
    fit_mu <- gam(meanY ~ s(argvals))
    mu <- as.vector(predict(fit_mu, newdata = data.frame(argvals = argvals)))
    rm(meanY, fit_mu)
  }))[-1L]
  starts <- which(vapply(expressions, identical, logical(1), expected[[1]]))
  if (length(starts) != 1L || starts + 3L > length(expressions) ||
      !all(vapply(seq_along(expected), function(i)
        identical(expressions[[starts + i - 1L]], expected[[i]]), logical(1))))
    stop("refund::mfpca.face mean block changed; review the local centering adapter.")
  expressions[[starts]] <- quote({
    if (!identical(twoway, FALSE)) stop("Externally centered fit requires twoway=FALSE")
    mu <- rep(0, L)
  })
  expressions <- expressions[-(starts + 1:3)]
  body(fun) <- as.call(expressions)
  fun
}

pupil_subject_means <- function(dat) {
  ids <- unique(dat$meta$subject_id)
  out <- t(vapply(ids, function(id)
    colMeans(dat$Y[dat$meta$subject_id == id, , drop = FALSE], na.rm = TRUE),
    numeric(ncol(dat$Y))))
  out[!is.finite(out)] <- NA_real_
  rownames(out) <- ids
  out
}

pupil_trap_weights <- function(x) {
  stopifnot(length(x) >= 2L, all(is.finite(x)), all(diff(x) > 0))
  d <- diff(x)
  c(d[1] / 2, if (length(x) > 2L) (head(d, -1) + tail(d, -1)) / 2,
    tail(d, 1) / 2)
}

pupil_project_scores <- function(Fmat, phi, w, min_coverage, ridge) {
  Fmat <- as.matrix(Fmat)
  phi <- as.matrix(phi)
  stopifnot(ncol(Fmat) == nrow(phi), length(w) == ncol(Fmat),
            ncol(phi) > 0L, all(is.finite(phi)), all(is.finite(w) & w > 0))
  scores <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow(Fmat), ncol(phi))
  coverage <- numeric(nrow(Fmat))
  status <- rep("insufficient_coverage", nrow(Fmat))
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(Fmat))) {
    obs <- is.finite(Fmat[i, ])
    coverage[i] <- sum(w[obs]) / sum(w)
    if (coverage[i] < min_coverage) next
    if (sum(obs) < ncol(phi)) {
      status[i] <- "insufficient_points"
      next
    }
    Xw <- phi[obs, , drop = FALSE] * sqrt(w[obs])
    yw <- Fmat[i, obs] * sqrt(w[obs])
    if (qr(Xw)$rank < ncol(phi)) {
      status[i] <- "rank_deficient"
      next
    }
    scores[i, ] <- tryCatch(
      solve(crossprod(Xw) + diag(ridge, ncol(phi)), crossprod(Xw, yw)),
      error = function(e) rep(NA_real_, ncol(phi)))
    status[i] <- if (all(is.finite(scores[i, ]))) "ok" else "solve_failed"
  }
  list(scores = scores, coverage = coverage, status = status)
}

make_pve_table <- function(evalues, returned_pve, level) {
  evalues <- as.numeric(evalues)
  returned_pve <- as.numeric(returned_pve)[1]
  # mfpca.face returns the cumulative PVE achieved by all returned PCs.
  total_variance <- sum(evalues) / returned_pve
  data.table(
    level = level,
    component = seq_along(evalues),
    eigenvalue = evalues,
    individual_pve = evalues / total_variance,
    cumulative_pve = cumsum(evalues) / total_variance
  )
}

finite_mean <- function(x) if(any(is.finite(x))) mean(x[is.finite(x)]) else NA_real_
symbols_p <- function(p) ifelse(is.na(p),'NA',ifelse(p<.001,'***',
  ifelse(p<.01,'**',ifelse(p<.05,'*','n.s.'))))
long_scores <- function(d,cols) melt(d,id.vars=c('subject_id','group','session_id'),
  measure.vars=cols,variable.name='component',value.name='value')
```

# 곡선 QC

## 입력 자료와 분석 격자

```{r input-qc}
if(!file.exists(params$data_file)) stop('Missing input RDS: ',params$data_file)
raw <- readRDS(params$data_file)
stopifnot(all(c('Y_original','curve_meta','argvals') %in% names(raw)))
m <- as.data.table(raw$curve_meta)
need <- c('subject_id','session_id','group','coverage','load','performance','reaction_time')
stopifnot(all(need %in% names(m)),nrow(raw$Y_original)==nrow(m),
          ncol(raw$Y_original)==length(raw$argvals))
m[,`:=`(input_row=.I,subject_id=as.character(subject_id),group=as.character(group),
        session_id=as.character(session_id))]
m[,excluded_subject:=subject_id %in% exclude]
m[,eligible:=!excluded_subject & group %in% groups & is.finite(coverage) & coverage>=params$min_coverage &
    load %in% params$load_codes]
idx <- seq.int(1L,ncol(raw$Y_original),by=params$downsample)
time <- as.numeric(raw$argvals[idx]); w <- pupil_trap_weights(time)
Yall <- raw$Y_original[,idx,drop=FALSE];Yall[!is.finite(Yall)] <- NA_real_
# Metadata coverage is computed on the original 8,000-point grid; projection
# coverage below is recomputed with quadrature weights on the 800-point grid.
m[,analysis_grid_coverage:=as.numeric(is.finite(Yall)%*%w/sum(w))]
standardization_audit <- data.table(
  measure=c('Median trial mean','Median trial SD'),
  value=c(median(rowMeans(Yall,na.rm=TRUE),na.rm=TRUE),
          median(apply(Yall,1,sd,na.rm=TRUE),na.rm=TRUE)))
qc <- m[,.(input_trials=.N,eligible_trials=sum(eligible),
           excluded_trials=sum(!eligible),excluded_subject_trials=sum(excluded_subject),
           input_participants=uniqueN(subject_id),retained_participants=uniqueN(subject_id[eligible])),by=group]
show_table(qc,'Input curve QC: metadata coverage >= 0.5; load codes 1/2')
show_table(standardization_audit,'Downsampled curve scale diagnostic; not a new transformation')
export_table(qc,'qc_flow')
export_table(m[,.(input_row,subject_id,session_id,group,coverage,analysis_grid_coverage,excluded_subject,eligible)],'curve_qc')
rm(raw);invisible(gc())
```

## 세션 평균과 표본 선택

```{r session-qc}
pm <- copy(m[eligible==TRUE]);setorder(pm,group,subject_id,session_id,input_row)
keys <- unique(pm[,.(subject_id,group,session_id)])
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(keys$session_id))
Y <- Yall[pm$input_row,,drop=FALSE]
means <- t(vapply(keys$session_id,function(s)
  colMeans(Y[pm$session_id==s,,drop=FALSE],na.rm=TRUE),numeric(length(time))))
means[!is.finite(means)] <- NA_real_
full <- rowSums(!is.finite(means))==0
session_qc <- cbind(keys,data.table(complete_mean=full,missing_grid=rowSums(!is.finite(means))))
stopifnot(!any(keys$subject_id %in% exclude))
show_table(session_qc,'Session mean grid QC')
export_table(session_qc,'session_qc')
counts <- pm[,.N,
             by=.(subject_id,group,session_id)]
sample_summary <- counts[,.(participants=uniqueN(subject_id),sessions=.N,
                           mean_trials=mean(N),total_trials=sum(N)),by=group]
show_table(sample_summary,'Curve-QC sample; WPC projection can reject additional trials')
export_table(sample_summary,'sample_summary')
```

# MFPCA: 규준 공간 적합 및 투영

## 대조군 규준 공간

```{r fit-reference}
cm <- copy(m[group=='Ctrl' & eligible==TRUE]);setorder(cm,subject_id,input_row)
stopifnot(!any(cm$subject_id %in% exclude))
cm[,visit_id:=seq_len(.N),by=subject_id]
export_table(unique(cm[,.(subject_id,group,session_id)]),'reference_participants')
YC <- Yall[cm$input_row,,drop=FALSE]
mu <- colMeans(pupil_subject_means(list(Y=YC,meta=cm)),na.rm=TRUE)
stopifnot(all(is.finite(mu)),all(colSums(is.finite(YC))>0),
          all(rowSums(is.finite(YC))>=2),uniqueN(cm$subject_id)>=2)
fit <- pupil_make_centered_face()(Y=sweep(YC,2,mu,'-'),
  id=factor(cm$subject_id,levels=unique(cm$subject_id)),visit=cm$visit_id,
  argvals=time,twoway=FALSE,weight='subj',npc=params$npc_max,npc2=params$npc_max,
  p=3,m=2,knots=35,silent=TRUE)
stopifnot(max(abs(fit$mu))<1e-6)
pve <- rbindlist(lapply(c('level1','level2'),function(lv)
  make_pve_table(fit$evalues[[lv]],fit$pve[[lv]],lv)))
choose_k <- function(lv) {
  hit <- pve[level==lv & cumulative_pve>=params$cve_target,component]
  if(!length(hit)) stop('CVE target not reached; increase npc_max.')
  min(hit)
}
KB <- choose_k('level1'); KW <- choose_k('level2')
normalize_basis <- function(P) sweep(P,2,sqrt(colSums(w*P^2)),'/')
PB <- normalize_basis(fit$efunctions$level1[,seq_len(KB),drop=FALSE])
PW <- normalize_basis(fit$efunctions$level2[,seq_len(KW),drop=FALSE])
bn <- paste0('BPC',seq_len(KB));wn <- paste0('WPC',seq_len(KW))
pve[,selected:=component<=ifelse(level=='level1',KB,KW)]
show_table(pve,'Native eigenvalues and total-variance-based PVE/CVE')
show_table(data.table(level=c('Between','Within'),retained=c(KB,KW),
  CVE=c(pve[level=='level1'&component==KB,cumulative_pve],
        pve[level=='level2'&component==KW,cumulative_pve])), 'Selected components')
show_table(data.table(reference_people=uniqueN(cm$subject_id),reference_trials=nrow(cm),
                     grid_points=length(time),time_start=min(time),time_end=max(time)))
stopifnot(max(abs(colSums(w*PB^2)-1))<1e-10,max(abs(colSums(w*PW^2)-1))<1e-10)
export_table(pve,'pve')
saveRDS(list(fit=fit,reference_mean=mu,PB=PB,PW=PW,time=time,weights=w,
             input_rows=cm$input_row,subject_ids=unique(cm$subject_id),params=params),file.path(out,'reference.rds'))
rm(Yall,YC);invisible(gc())
```

## BPC와 WPC 점수

```{r projection}
B <- sweep(means[full,,drop=FALSE],2,mu,'-')%*%(w*PB);colnames(B)<-bn
between_all <- cbind(keys[full],as.data.table(B))
ti <- match(pm$session_id,keys$session_id)
residual <- Y-means[ti,,drop=FALSE]
centering_audit <- rbindlist(lapply(seq_len(nrow(keys)),function(i) {
  z <- colMeans(residual[ti==i,,drop=FALSE],na.rm=TRUE)
  err <- max(abs(z[is.finite(z)]))
  stopifnot(err<1e-10)
  cbind(keys[i],data.table(max_abs_residual_mean=err))
}))
Wp <- pupil_project_scores(residual,PW,w,params$min_coverage,1e-8)
colnames(Wp$scores)<-wn
within_all <- cbind(pm[,.(subject_id,group,session_id,input_row)],as.data.table(Wp$scores),
                   projection_status=Wp$status,projection_coverage=Wp$coverage)
show_table(within_all[,.N,by=.(group,projection_status)],'WPC projection audit')
show_table(centering_audit[,.(max_abs_residual_mean=max(max_abs_residual_mean))])
between <- between_all[!subject_id %in% exclude]
within <- within_all[projection_status=='ok' & !subject_id %in% exclude]
session_within <- within[,c(list(n_trials=.N),setNames(lapply(.SD,var),paste0(wn,'_var'))),
                         by=.(subject_id,group,session_id),.SDcols=wn]
show_table(session_within[,.(participants=uniqueN(subject_id),sessions=.N,
  projected_trials=sum(n_trials),mean_projected_trials=mean(n_trials)),by=group])
show_table(head(between),'BPC session scores (first six rows; all rows in CSV)')
show_table(head(session_within),'WPC session variances (first six rows; all rows in CSV)')
export_table(between,'between_scores');export_table(within,'within_scores')
export_table(session_within,'within_session_variance');export_table(centering_audit,'centering_audit')
export_table(within_all[,.(subject_id,session_id,input_row,projection_status,projection_coverage)],'projection_qc')
```

# 통계 분석

## 집단 차이: LMM, BH 보정 및 사후비교

```{r lmm-analysis}
bl <- long_scores(between,bn);bl[,family:='BPC mean']
wl <- long_scores(session_within,paste0(wn,'_var'))
wl[,`:=`(component=sub('_var$','',component),family='WPC log variance')]
dat <- rbind(bl,wl);dat[,group:=factor(group,levels=groups)]
stopifnot(all(is.finite(dat$value)),all(wl$value>0))
dat[,test_value:=value]
dat[family=='WPC log variance',test_value:=log(value)]
models<-list();omni<-list();post<-list();paired_list<-list()
for(pc in unique(as.character(dat$component))) {
  d<-dat[component==pc]
  fm<-lmer(test_value~group+(1|subject_id),data=d,REML=FALSE)
  f0<-lmer(test_value~1+(1|subject_id),data=d,REML=FALSE)
  lr<-anova(f0,fm)
  msg<-fm@optinfo$conv$lme4$messages
  omni[[pc]]<-data.table(component=pc,family=d$family[1],n=nrow(d),
    chisq=lr$Chisq[2],df=lr$Df[2],p=lr$`Pr(>Chisq)`[2],singular=isSingular(fm),
    convergence_message=if(is.null(msg)) '' else paste(msg,collapse='; '))
  X<-model.matrix(~group,data.frame(group=factor(groups,levels=groups)))
  beta<-fixef(fm);V<-as.matrix(vcov(fm));X<-X[,names(beta),drop=FALSE]
  ij<-combn(1:3,2)
  L<-t(vapply(seq_len(ncol(ij)),function(j)X[ij[2,j],]-X[ij[1,j],],numeric(length(beta))))
  est<-as.vector(L%*%beta);se<-sqrt(diag(L%*%V%*%t(L)));pv<-2*pnorm(-abs(est/se))
  post[[pc]]<-data.table(component=pc,family=d$family[1],group1=groups[ij[1,]],group2=groups[ij[2,]],
    difference=est,SE=se,z=est/se,p_raw=pv,p_Holm=p.adjust(pv,'holm'),
    lower=est-qnorm(.975)*se,upper=est+qnorm(.975)*se)
  z<-dcast(d[group!='Ctrl'],subject_id~group,value.var='test_value')
  z<-z[is.finite(`off-ADHD`)&is.finite(`on-ADHD`)]
  tt<-t.test(z$`on-ADHD`,z$`off-ADHD`,paired=TRUE)
  paired_list[[pc]]<-data.table(component=pc,family=d$family[1],n_pairs=nrow(z),
    mean_change=mean(z$`on-ADHD`-z$`off-ADHD`),lower=tt$conf.int[1],upper=tt$conf.int[2],p=tt$p.value)
  models[[pc]]<-fm
}
omnibus<-rbindlist(omni);omnibus[,q:=p.adjust(p,'BH'),by=family];omnibus[,symbol:=symbols_p(q)]
posthoc<-merge(rbindlist(post),omnibus[,.(component,omnibus_q=q)],by='component',sort=FALSE)
posthoc[,`:=`(symbol=symbols_p(p_Holm),confirmatory_gate=omnibus_q<.05,
  variance_ratio=ifelse(family=='WPC log variance',exp(difference),NA_real_))]
paired<-rbindlist(paired_list);paired[,q:=p.adjust(p,'BH'),by=family]
descriptive<-dat[,.(n=.N,mean=mean(value),sd=sd(value),median=median(value)),by=.(family,component,group)]
show_table(omnibus,'LMM omnibus LRT; BH within each level')
show_table(posthoc[confirmatory_gate==TRUE],'Same-model posthoc: group2 minus group1')
show_table(paired,'Paired On-Off sensitivity; BH within each level')
show_table(descriptive,'Observed score/variance summaries')
export_table(omnibus,'lmm_omnibus');export_table(posthoc,'lmm_posthoc')
export_table(paired,'paired_sensitivity');export_table(descriptive,'descriptive')
saveRDS(models,file.path(out,'lmm_models.rds'))
```

## 행동지표와 Pearson 상관

```{r behavior-correlations}
behavior<-m[group %in% groups & load %in% params$load_codes & !subject_id %in% exclude,{
  valid<-performance %in% c(0,1)
  rt<-reaction_time[performance %in% 1 & is.finite(reaction_time) &
    reaction_time>=params$rt_min_ms & reaction_time<=params$rt_max_ms]
  .(n_behavior_trials=.N,n_accuracy=sum(valid),n_rt=length(rt),
    accuracy=if(any(valid))mean(performance[valid]) else NA_real_,
    rt_sd=if(length(rt)>=max(2,params$min_rt_trials))sd(rt) else NA_real_)
},by=.(subject_id,group)]
bperson<-between[,lapply(.SD,finite_mean),by=.(subject_id,group),.SDcols=bn]
wperson<-within[,setNames(lapply(.SD,var),paste0(wn,'_var')),by=.(subject_id,group),.SDcols=wn]
people<-Reduce(function(x,y)merge(x,y,by=c('subject_id','group'),all=TRUE),list(behavior,bperson,wperson))
metrics<-c(bn,paste0(wn,'_var'))
cl<-melt(people,id.vars=c('subject_id','group','accuracy','rt_sd'),measure.vars=metrics,
         variable.name='metric',value.name='pupil_value')
cl<-melt(cl,id.vars=c('subject_id','group','metric','pupil_value'),measure.vars=c('accuracy','rt_sd'),
         variable.name='outcome',value.name='behavior_value')
correlations<-cl[,{
  keep<-is.finite(pupil_value)&is.finite(behavior_value);x<-pupil_value[keep];y<-behavior_value[keep]
  if(length(x)>=4 && sd(x)>0 && sd(y)>0) {
    ct<-cor.test(x,y,method='pearson')
    .(n=length(x),r=unname(ct$estimate),lower=ct$conf.int[1],upper=ct$conf.int[2],p=ct$p.value)
  } else .(n=length(x),r=NA_real_,lower=NA_real_,upper=NA_real_,p=NA_real_)
},by=.(group,metric,outcome)]
correlations[,q:=p.adjust(p,'BH')]
stopifnot(nrow(correlations)==length(groups)*length(metrics)*2)
show_table(correlations,'All Pearson correlations: n, r, unadjusted 95% CI, p, BH q')
export_table(people,'behavior_participants');export_table(correlations,'correlations')
stopifnot(!any(between$subject_id %in% exclude),!any(within$subject_id %in% exclude),
          !any(people$subject_id %in% exclude))
```

# 시각화

## 규준 공간 주요 그림 4개

```{r normative-four-panels, fig.width=13, fig.height=8}
windows<-data.table(label=c('Array 1','Array 2','Array 3','Distr','Probe'),
  start=c(0,1300,2600,3900,4950),end=c(750,2050,3350,4400,6450))
timing_source<-'Nominal illustration; probe end = onset + 1500 ms'
if(file.exists(params$timing_file)) {
  timing<-fread(params$timing_file)
  onset_cols<-c('array1_ms','array2_ms','array3_ms','distractor_ms','probe_ms')
  stopifnot(all(c(onset_cols,'feedback_ms','probe_to_feedback_ms') %in% names(timing)))
  windows[,start:=vapply(onset_cols,function(n)median(timing[[n]],na.rm=TRUE),numeric(1))]
  windows[,end:=c(start[1:4]+c(750,750,750,500),
    median(timing[is.finite(feedback_ms)&is.finite(probe_to_feedback_ms),feedback_ms]))]
  timing_source<-'Observed onset/feedback medians; array/distractor nominal durations'
}
show_table(windows,timing_source)
events<-function()list(
  geom_rect(data=windows,aes(xmin=start,xmax=end,ymin=-Inf,ymax=Inf),
            inherit.aes=FALSE,fill='grey92',color=NA),
  geom_vline(data=windows,aes(xintercept=start),inherit.aes=FALSE,
             color='grey65',linetype='dashed',linewidth=.35),
  scale_x_continuous(name='Time (ms)',limits=c(0,8000),breaks=seq(0,8000,2000),
    expand=expansion(mult=c(0,.015)),
    sec.axis=dup_axis(name=NULL,breaks=(windows$start+windows$end)/2,labels=windows$label)),
  theme(axis.text.x.top=element_text(size=8,face='bold'),axis.ticks.x.top=element_blank()))
eigen_plot<-function(P,prefix,palette) {
  pcs<-paste0(prefix,seq_len(ncol(P)))
  d<-data.table(time=rep(time*1000,ncol(P)),value=as.vector(P),
    component=factor(rep(pcs,each=length(time)),levels=pcs))
  ggplot(d,aes(time,value,color=component))+events()+
    geom_hline(yintercept=0,color='grey80',linewidth=.35)+geom_line(linewidth=.9)+
    scale_color_manual(values=palette[pcs])+labs(y='Normalized eigenfunction',color=NULL)+
    theme(legend.key.width=grid::unit(.65,'cm'),legend.text=element_text(size=10),
          legend.spacing.x=grid::unit(.08,'cm'))+guides(color=guide_legend(nrow=1,byrow=TRUE))
}
p_mu<-ggplot(data.table(time=time*1000,mu),aes(time,mu))+events()+
  geom_line(color='black',linewidth=1.4)+labs(y='Pupil response (z-score)')
p_cve<-ggplot(pve,aes(component,100*cumulative_pve,color=level,shape=level))+
  geom_hline(yintercept=c(80,90,95),linetype='dotted',color='grey65',linewidth=.4)+
  geom_line(linewidth=1)+geom_point(size=2.3)+scale_x_continuous(breaks=seq_len(params$npc_max))+
  scale_y_continuous(limits=c(0,100),breaks=c(0,20,40,60,80,90,95,100),expand=expansion(mult=c(0,.02)))+
  scale_color_manual(values=c(level1='#5DB8A6',level2='#CC785C'),labels=c(level1='Between',level2='Within'))+
  scale_shape_manual(values=c(level1=16,level2=17),labels=c(level1='Between',level2='Within'))+
  labs(x='Number of components',y='CVE (%)',color=NULL,shape=NULL)+
  theme(legend.position='inside',legend.position.inside=c(.97,.05),legend.justification=c(1,0),
        legend.direction='vertical',legend.background=element_rect(fill='white',color=NA))
p_b<-eigen_plot(PB,'BPC',b_palette);p_w<-eigen_plot(PW,'WPC',w_palette)
p_four<-(p_mu|p_cve)/(p_b|p_w)
print(p_four)
export_plot(p_four,'01_normative_four_panels',12.8,8)
for(n in c('p_mu','p_cve','p_b','p_w'))export_plot(get(n),paste0('normative_',n),6.4,4)
for(prefix in c('BPC','WPC')) {
  base_plot<-if(prefix=='BPC')p_b else p_w
  for(pc in levels(base_plot$data$component)) {
    single<-(base_plot %+% base_plot$data[component==pc])+coord_cartesian(ylim=range(base_plot$data$value))
    export_plot(single,paste0('eigen_',pc),6.4,4)
  }
}
```

## 평균 ±1SD: BPC2, WPC1, WPC2

```{r sd-patterns, fig.width=13, fig.height=4.5}
mode_data<-function(lv,k,prefix) {
  effect<-sqrt(fit$evalues[[lv]][k])*fit$efunctions[[lv]][,k]
  data.table(time=rep(time*1000,3),value=c(mu,mu+effect,mu-effect),
    curve=factor(rep(c('Mean','Mean + 1 SD','Mean - 1 SD'),each=length(mu)),
                 levels=c('Mean','Mean + 1 SD','Mean - 1 SD')),component=paste0(prefix,k))
}
sd_data<-rbind(mode_data('level1',2,'BPC'),mode_data('level2',1,'WPC'),mode_data('level2',2,'WPC'))
sd_data[,color_key:=ifelse(curve=='Mean','Mean',component)]
sd_plot<-function(d,ncol=1) {
  ggplot(d,aes(time,value,color=color_key,linetype=curve))+events()+geom_line(linewidth=.95)+
    facet_wrap(~component,ncol=ncol)+coord_cartesian(ylim=range(sd_data$value))+
    theme(panel.spacing.x=grid::unit(.65,'cm'))+
    scale_color_manual(values=c(Mean='black',b_palette,w_palette),guide='none')+
    scale_linetype_manual(values=c('Mean'='solid','Mean + 1 SD'='solid','Mean - 1 SD'='22'))+
    labs(y='Pupil response (z-score)',linetype=NULL)
}
p_sd<-sd_plot(sd_data,3)
print(p_sd);export_plot(p_sd,'02_mean_plus_minus_sd',12.8,4)
for(pc in unique(sd_data$component))export_plot(sd_plot(sd_data[component==pc]),paste0('sd_',pc,'_panel'),6.4,4)
export_table(sd_data,'sd_curves')
```

## 상자 그림

```{r boxplots, fig.width=22, fig.height=5.5}
plot_box<-function(fam) {
  d<-copy(dat[family==fam]);logy<-fam=='WPC log variance'
  r<-range(if(logy)log10(d$value) else d$value);span<-diff(r)
  inv<-function(x)if(logy)10^x else x
  ph<-copy(posthoc[family==fam & confirmatory_gate==TRUE])
  ph[,`:=`(x1=match(group1,groups),x2=match(group2,groups))]
  ph[,row:=ifelse(x1==1&x2==2,1,ifelse(x1==2&x2==3,2,3))]
  ph[,`:=`(y=inv(r[2]+span*(.12+.15*(row-1))),tip=inv(r[2]+span*(.09+.15*(row-1))),
           label_y=inv(r[2]+span*(.15+.15*(row-1))))]
  labels<-omnibus[family==fam,setNames(paste(component,symbol),component)]
  p<-ggplot(d,aes(as.numeric(group),value,color=group))+
    geom_boxplot(aes(group=group),outlier.shape=NA,width=.42,linewidth=.45)+
    geom_point(position=position_jitter(width=.12,seed=1),alpha=.55,size=1.3)+
    geom_segment(data=ph,aes(x=x1,xend=x2,y=y,yend=y),inherit.aes=FALSE,linewidth=.35)+
    geom_segment(data=ph,aes(x=x1,xend=x1,y=y,yend=tip),inherit.aes=FALSE,linewidth=.35)+
    geom_segment(data=ph,aes(x=x2,xend=x2,y=y,yend=tip),inherit.aes=FALSE)+
    geom_text(data=ph,aes(x=(x1+x2)/2,y=label_y,label=symbol),inherit.aes=FALSE,size=3)+
    facet_wrap(~component,nrow=1,labeller=as_labeller(labels))+
    scale_color_manual(values=cols)+scale_x_continuous(breaks=1:3,labels=groups)+
    labs(x=NULL,y=if(logy)'WPC variance (log scale)' else 'BPC score')+
    theme(legend.position='none',axis.text.x=element_text(angle=45,hjust=1,size=9))
  if(logy)p<-p+scale_y_log10() else p<-p+scale_y_continuous()
  p
}
p_box_b<-plot_box('BPC mean');p_box_w<-plot_box('WPC log variance')
p_boxes<-(p_box_b|p_box_w)+plot_layout(widths=c(KB,KW))+
  plot_annotation(caption=sprintf('Facet: LMM LRT BH q (BPC: %d; WPC: %d). Bracket: same-model Wald z Holm p (3 pairs per PC).\n* < .05; ** < .01; *** < .001; n.s. >= .05.',KB,KW),
                  theme=theme(plot.caption=element_text(size=10,hjust=0)))
print(p_boxes);export_plot(p_boxes,'03_boxplots',22,5.5)
export_plot(p_box_b,'boxplots_BPC_LMM',11,5.5)
export_plot(p_box_w,'boxplots_WPC_LMM',13,5.5)
```

## 행동 상관 히트맵

```{r correlation-heatmap, fig.width=12, fig.height=5.2}
hm<-copy(correlations)
hm[,`:=`(metric=factor(metric,levels=metrics),group=factor(group,levels=rev(groups)),
  outcome=factor(outcome,levels=c('accuracy','rt_sd'),labels=c('Accuracy','Correct-trial RT variability (SD)')),
  label=ifelse(is.finite(r),sprintf('%.2f',r),'NA'))]
p_heat<-ggplot(hm,aes(metric,group,fill=r))+geom_tile(color='white',linewidth=.9)+
  geom_vline(xintercept=KB+.5,color='#666666',linewidth=.6)+
  geom_text(aes(label=label),size=4.3,color='#202020')+facet_grid(outcome~.)+
  scale_x_discrete(labels=function(x)sub('_var$','',x),expand=c(0,0))+
  scale_y_discrete(labels=c('Ctrl'='Control','off-ADHD'='Off-ADHD','on-ADHD'='On-ADHD'),expand=c(0,0))+
  scale_fill_gradient2(low='#2166AC',mid='#FFFFFF',high='#B2182B',midpoint=0,
                       limits=c(-1,1),breaks=seq(-1,1,.5),na.value='grey85',name='Pearson r')+
  labs(x=NULL,y=NULL,caption='BPC: between-person scores | WPC: within-person score variances')+
  guides(fill=guide_colorbar(direction='vertical',title.position='top',
    barwidth=grid::unit(.45,'cm'),barheight=grid::unit(5,'cm')))+
  theme_minimal(base_size=13)+theme(panel.grid=element_blank(),
    strip.text.y=element_text(angle=90,face='bold',size=10),
    strip.background=element_rect(fill='#F0F0F0',color=NA),
    axis.text.x=element_text(color='black',size=12),axis.text.y=element_text(color='black',size=12),
    panel.spacing.y=grid::unit(.3,'cm'),legend.position='right',legend.title=element_text(size=11),
    plot.caption=element_text(hjust=0,size=10,color='#444444'),plot.margin=margin(10,12,10,10))
print(p_heat);export_plot(p_heat,'04_correlation_heatmap',12,5.2)
```
